protected_properties: Round 5 terminal result cannot be reset or relabeled
only one v2 transition exists for the frozen source and target
old branch-only artifacts cannot become successor implementation or success evidence
review principals, stages, heads, findings, and budget cannot be substituted
a stale main or incomplete GitHub inventory cannot become accepted
policy merge cannot activate runtime privilege
adversaries_and_failures: caller-controlled identifiers and arbitrary digest values
duplicate, edited, deleted, replayed, or cross-repository Owner comments
concurrent grant records or ambiguous write responses
Issue, PR, branch, head, scope, or reviewer replacement used as a budget reset
frozen commit, blob, patch, test, schema, review, Check, or attestation reuse
main movement between V2, Owner decision, merge, and accepted readback
partial pagination, duplicate matching records, unknown fields, or missing readback
solo Owner compromise, which remains an explicitly unsupported threat
threat_model.fail_closed_rule: Unknown, incomplete, duplicated, edited, stale, mismatched, over-budget, or unsupported input halts the program without a successor grant.

forbidden_changes: OpenAPI or generated API types in G0
runtime, workflow, GitHub App, Environment, Ruleset, credential, Check, merge, or activation changes in G0
paths outside the exact G0 set or successor allowlist without terminal rejection of this program
artifact_scope.path_matching: Exact paths match byte-for-byte; a prefix ending in slash permits descendants; the workflow prefix permits only basenames beginning loop-engineer-v2-.

other_allowed_inputs: the exact terminal manifest and its canonical findings projection
public standards and public GitHub documentation
new v2 requirements, threat model, oracle, and implementation created in G0-G3

candidate_checks: branch-only blob OID equality for added or modified blobs

review_policy.snapshot_definition: One stage bundle containing exactly one record from each of the three fixed roles over identical bound inputs; role records are not three snapshots.
stage_machine: D1_PENDING -> D1_COMPLETED when one complete D1 bundle has P0=0
D1_COMPLETED -> IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETED after the initial candidate is committed
IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETED -> V1_COMPLETED after one complete exact-head V1 bundle
V1_COMPLETED -> REMEDIATION_CONSUMED only when V1 P1>0 and the finding backlog digest is fixed
V1_COMPLETED -> V2_PENDING when V1 P1=0; V2 remains mandatory on the same head
REMEDIATION_CONSUMED -> V2_PENDING after exactly one remediation commit batch
V2_PENDING -> V2_COMPLETED after one complete exact-final-head V2 bundle
V2_COMPLETED -> OWNER_DECISION_PENDING only when P0=0 and P1=0
P0 at any stage, P0 or P1 at V2, duplicate stage, principal replacement, scope change, or an attempt beyond budget -> PROGRAM_TERMINAL_HOLD

main_freshness.v2_binding: Every V2 role record binds the same reviewed_base_main_sha and reviewed_head_sha.
main_freshness.grant_binding: decision_main_sha and final_governance_head_sha exactly equal the V2 bundle values.
main_freshness.merge_precondition: Immediately before merge, current main equals decision_main_sha and the PR is strictly up to date under the active GitHub Ruleset.
main_freshness.accepted_readback: The merged PR head equals final_governance_head_sha, the merge commit first parent equals decision_main_sha, and the accepted main tree equals the final head tree.
main_freshness.main_movement: Any main movement after V2 terminally rejects and consumes this transition; no refresh, rebase, update-branch, new head, or extra review is allowed.

storage.body_format: one JSON object and one trailing LF; no Markdown fence or prose
storage.inventory: paginate all Issue comments through hasNextPage=false; reject missing pages, duplicate cursors, duplicate records, edited records, and unknown matching records

state_reducer: Exactly one valid unexpired issued record and an open unmerged PR -> ISSUED
Two or more matching issued records, any unknown field, edit, mismatch, replay, or ambiguous inventory -> PROGRAM_TERMINAL_HOLD
ISSUED plus PR closed unmerged, explicit unique Owner reject event, or expiry -> REJECTED_CONSUMED
ISSUED plus exact GitHub merge and accepted-readback invariants -> ACCEPTED_CONSUMED
ACCEPTED_CONSUMED, REJECTED_CONSUMED, and PROGRAM_TERMINAL_HOLD are immutable terminal states
After ACCEPTED_CONSUMED, cancellation appends a distinct program_halted record and never rewrites the grant
grant_record_contract.idempotency: Repeated readback of the same comment ID, event ID, merge commit, and accepted tree returns the same state without adding a record.
